description: Voucher of the store carrying the declared account's UserId (any restriction) with at least N transactions (ZnodeGiftCardHistory). Outputs: name, amount, remainingAmount, startDate, expirationDate, firstTransactionOrderNumber. KB: Managing Vouchers.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId the vouchers carry (ZnodeGiftCard.UserId): link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username. Left out (verification only): any owner

minTransactions.description: Fewest redemptions (transactions linked to an order) the voucher must have

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode); a voucher belongs to one store
